source_documents.title: Electron‐Rich Cores Empower Organic C‐Shaped Dyes With Emission Peaking Around 1000 nm, 14.3% PLQY, and >3% EQE in OLEDs

reference_evidence_units.quote: This molecular architecture synergistically enhances intramolecular charge transfer (ICT) while suppressing internal reorganization energy through increased molecular rigidity.
reference_evidence_units.subject: CT series
reference_evidence_units.statement: Design: stronger ICT plus smaller internal reorganization energy.

reference_evidence_units.quote: As the emission energy gap decreases, the non-radiative decay rate (kic ) increases exponentially, leading to a steep drop in internal quantum
reference_evidence_units.subject: NIR emitters

reference_evidence_units.quote: The results in Table 1 indicate that substituting sulfur with selenium leads to a systematic reduction in internal reorganization energy relative to CB12.
reference_evidence_units.subject: CT-Se, CT-2Se
reference_evidence_units.statement: Se lowers the internal reorganization energy.

reference_evidence_units.quote: CT-F, CT-Se, and CT-2Se exhibit emission maxima/Φem values of 970 nm/14.26%, 974 nm/13.39%, and 985 nm/11.61%, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: CT series

reference_evidence_units.quote: Such delocalization effectively suppresses electron–phonon coupling in narrow-bandgap systems, thereby mitigating the energy-gap law and reducing non-radiative decay, leading to enhanced NIR OLED performance.
reference_evidence_units.subject: CT series
reference_evidence_units.statement: Delocalised excitons couple weakly to vibrations, lowering knr.

reference_evidence_units.quote: While Se incorporation intrinsically reduces λint , the dual-selenium structure in CT-2Se significantly facilitates kISC and knr via enhanced spin-orbit coupling.
reference_evidence_units.subject: CT-2Se vs CT-Se
reference_evidence_units.statement: The second Se adds an ISC loss channel that outweighs the smaller reorganization energy.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This superior coplanarity reflects enhanced molecular rigidity, a feature conducive to minimizing internal reorganization energy.
reference_evidence_units.subject: CT-Se
reference_evidence_units.statement: Core torsion 3.24 deg in CT-Se vs 6.3 deg in the S analogues; Se...O 2.63 A lock.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The solventdependent emission studies in Figure S2 further reveal that the external reorganization energy remains small despite the enhanced intramolecular charge transfer.
reference_evidence_units.subject: CT series
reference_evidence_units.statement: ICT character with small solvatochromic relaxation.

contrast_group.paper_difference: Both have low reorganization energy; the second Se raises knr through spin-orbit-coupling-assisted ISC, so CT-2Se has the lower PLQY (11.6% vs 13.4%).
